# Veriphone

Veriphone is a REST-based JSON API that provides phone number validation services, allowing developers to verify the validity, type, carrier, and region of phone numbers.

Category: Developer. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/veriphone/.

## Actions

- **Verify Phone Number** (read-only): Verify if a phone number is valid.
- **Get Example Phone Number** (read-only): Retrieve an example phone number for a specified country and type.
